query_text: Transfer money to my savings account

content.text:
I'm sorry, but I'm unable to transfer money to your savings account. I don't have access to any banking or financial tools that would allow me to perform financial transactions.

To transfer money to your savings account, you can:

1. **Use your bank's mobile app** – Most banks have a mobile application that allows you to transfer funds between accounts easily.
2. **Log in to your bank's website** – You can use your bank's online banking portal to initiate a transfer.
3. **Call your bank** – You can call your bank's customer service line and request a transfer.
4. **Visit a branch** – You can visit your nearest bank branch and speak to a teller to make the transfer.
5. **Use an ATM** – Some ATMs allow you to transfer funds between linked accounts.

Please make sure to have your account details handy when attempting any of these options. If you need help with anything else, feel free to ask!
